text: Live Trillium verification after MFA: installed fmrireg 0.2.0@886ae4bb8212f0eab4662d279fc5dc20d9364e28, fmridesign 0.6.0@e627d4d1861e5cc4aea5a5668d6052e394429b92, fmrihrf 0.4.0@d366e79fce8db7c5c46e883291e73732b20c545c, and fmridataset 0.10.0.9000@7f9cf93c6694c04915677be03d70c7a0f6616b1c. All three real numerical failures record no fmrireg warning. Existing report metadata: MSC01 func10 glasslexical02 retained 112, 54 non-spike columns, 80 spikes, rank 54, df 58, scaled kappa 24931; MSC02 func05 glasslexical01 retained 133, 55 non-spike, 59 spikes, rank 55, df 78, kappa 2361; MSC10 func01 glasslexical02 retained 121, 57 non-spike, 71 spikes, rank 57, df 64, kappa 3563. fmridesign task columns agree with the analytic construction to about 5e-12 in every case. This strengthens the spike-augmented fmrireg solve hypothesis while leaving exact attribution pending a pinned real-design reproduction. Trillium squeue is empty.
